4,336 likes, 50 comments - fit.khurana on October 27, 2026: "Location ⬇️

Bang Kang Wat (Chiang Mai) - 20 mins from the old city. It’s a very small village with little cafes to grab coffee and stalls selling baked goodies! You can spend an entire day just doing different DIY activities and exploring your artistic side❤️✨ Best part? No cars or honking and carry all the cash in the world to shop for the cutest handmade items😭🤌🏻 

Should I cover more auch hidden finds?  Batao✅ I am experimenting with slow travel content, so really need your feedback❤️❤️
